title: Hurt body healed mind spent few days offline cooking on campfires stacking stone walls tilling soil, mending fences, muscles ache skin lacerated pain
summary: Hurt body healed mind spent few days offline cooking on campfires stacking stone walls tilling soil, mending fences, muscles ache skin lacerated pain fade art stands #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Hurt body
  healed mind
spent few days
  offline
cooking on campfires
  stacking stone walls
tilling soil, mending
  fences,
muscles ache
skin lacerated
pain fade
    art stands
#smallpoems
